title: AI & Business Automation Lead
description: AI & Business Automation Lead, Natali Healthcare Solutions UK Ltd. Southampton, hybrid. Salary competitive, dependent on experience. Reporting to the CEO. Develop and deliver a group-wide AI and business automation strategy across a group of homecare businesses; evaluate systems, workflows and processes for automation; prioritised transformation roadmap; hands-on design and deployment of AI-powered solutions, automated workflows and system integrations; lead projects from business case to implementation, training and adoption; build confidence in AI across the organisation, support change; business cases with ROI; KPIs; data protection and regulatory requirements in a regulated healthcare environment. Looking for: experience implementing AI, automation or digital transformation with business results; workflow automation, systems integration; project management from concept to adoption; stakeholder management with senior leadership; Microsoft Power Automate, Power Apps, Power BI, Make, Zapier, AI assistants and API integrations advantageous. Healthcare experience beneficial, not essential.
